method: Real browser UI only. Create isolated TEST department/team, positions and accounts; log in separately; inspect actual API responses; test each page and sidebar. No direct API calls, mocked permissions or edits to existing users.
coverageNotes: The suite verifies real-account login, exact assigned permissions, sidebar links and admission to 26 protected page URLs per account. Denied pages issue no protected-data requests.
Allowed refers to page admission, not bypass of the API record-access or data-scope rules. API error responses are preserved per page.

The all profile has all 11 permissions available in the position-permission catalog. can_process and can_hr_rec are not in that catalog; these isolated accounts are not processing-group members, so tasks and recruitment-list pages remain denied.
can_search and can_delete do not grant entry to an independent page in the current route mapping.
Only TEST department/team, positions and users were created. No existing user or ticket was edited. Passwords and tokens are not stored in artifacts.

recordAccessObservation.result: API denied reading an existing ticket belonging to another account even though can_view admits the detail page.

setupObservation.reason: Description exceeded the backend limit of 150 characters.
setupObservation.resolution: Shortened the TEST description, then created the position and account successfully. Completed profiles were reused.

latestRegressionRun.environment: Local production build at 127.0.0.1:5189; real Ticket API; browser UI interactions only.

fixes: Preserve explicit API can_process grants when is_handling is false.
